C0937.title: First National Case: Professional Credit Card 'Anti-Collection' Agent Convicted of Extortion
C0937.summary: In February 2022, Ping An Bank's credit card center discovered that complainant Liu was linked to multiple malicious complaints. Investigation found that Liu engaged in illegal complaint-agency services, impersonated clients' spouses to file malicious complaints and seek compensation, and charged clients fees. Liu was sentenced to one year and three months in prison for extortion, marking a reported first national credit-card proxy-rights case convicted as extortion.
